app.title: AWS emulator
app.description: Container-based emulator that mocks AWS services for local development and testing.
proposed_tests: Pull the Docker image and run the emulator, verifying the health endpoint responds.
Use AWS CLI to list S3 buckets against the emulator and confirm empty bucket list.
Create a new S3 bucket via SDK and verify it appears in the bucket list.
Measure the time to perform a PutObject operation for a 1MB file.
